title: Acceptance bound for an unsatisfiable circuit
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $D$ be a PCPP description for the property accepted by $C$. If $C$ accepts no input, then the verifier's maximum acceptance probability over all input words and proof words is strictly less than $1$ minus the rejection rate of $D$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ bits
$D$ is a PCPP description for the property accepted by $C
